alt.id: Ibu membuka pintu untuk teman yang datang. Teman melambai: "你好！" Ibu membalas: "你好！请进！"
alt.en: Mom opens the door to a friend who has come over. The friend waves: "你好！" Mom answers: "你好！请进！"

alt.id: Di taman, teman mengembalikan bola Adik yang jatuh; Adik menunjuk teman itu sambil tersenyum: "谢谢你！"
alt.en: In the park, a friend hands back the ball Little Sister dropped; she points at the friend and smiles: "谢谢你！"

alt.id: Adik mengangkat gambar buatannya; Ibu tersenyum dan mengacungkan jempol: "很好！"
alt.en: Little Sister holds up the picture she drew; Mom smiles and gives a thumbs-up: "很好！"

alt.id: Adik membungkuk sopan kepada Kakek dan berkata "爷爷，您好！"; Kakek tersenyum.
alt.en: Little Sister bows politely to Grandpa and says "爷爷，您好！"; Grandpa smiles.

alt.id: Bu Guru membuka tangan ke arah Kakak dan temannya: "你们好！"
alt.en: The teacher opens her hand toward Big Brother and his classmate: "你们好！"

alt.id: Ibu menyodorkan piring berisi jeruk kepada teman yang datang: "请吃水果！"
alt.en: Mom holds out a plate of oranges to a visiting friend: "请吃水果！"

alt.id: Di toko, Ibu mengangkat tangan dengan sopan dan bertanya kepada penjual: "请问，牛奶在哪儿？"
alt.en: In a shop, Mom politely raises her hand and asks the seller: "请问，牛奶在哪儿？"

alt.id: Ayah memberi Adik balon: "给你。" Adik senang: "谢谢爸爸！"
alt.en: Dad gives Little Sister a balloon: "给你。" She is happy: "谢谢爸爸！"

alt.id: Panel 1: Adik berterima kasih kepada Kakak karena bolanya: "谢谢！" Panel 2: Kakak melambai santai: "不客气！"
alt.en: Panel 1: Little Sister thanks Big Brother for her ball: "谢谢！" Panel 2: he waves it off casually: "不客气！"

alt.id: Kakak menumpahkan teh di meja Ayah, lalu membungkuk: "爸爸，对不起！" Ayah menjawab: "没关系。"
alt.en: Big Brother spilled tea on Dad’s table and bows: "爸爸，对不起！" Dad answers: "没关系。"

alt.id: Panel 1: Adik menabrak Nenek, jeruk jatuh: "对不起！" Panel 2: Nenek tersenyum dan melambai: "没关系！"
alt.en: Panel 1: Little Sister bumps into Grandma and oranges fall: "对不起！" Panel 2: Grandma smiles and waves: "没关系！"

alt.id: Di gerbang sekolah, Adik membawa tas dan melambai: "老师再见！" Bu Guru membalas: "再见！明天见！"
alt.en: At the school gate, Little Sister carries her bag and waves: "老师再见！" The teacher answers: "再见！明天见！"

alt.id: Adik menawarkan bakpao kepada Kakak: "你吃包子吗？" Kakak menjawab: "好，谢谢！"
alt.en: Little Sister offers Big Brother a steamed bun: "你吃包子吗？" He answers: "好，谢谢！"

alt.id: Adik menggigit bakpao hangat dan tersenyum lebar: "很好吃！"
alt.en: Little Sister bites into a warm steamed bun and grins: "很好吃！"

alt.id: Panel 1: Ibu menunjuk dirinya: "我喝茶，" Panel 2: Ibu menunjuk Ayah: "你呢？" Ayah menjawab: "我也喝茶。"
alt.en: Panel 1: Mom points at herself: "我喝茶，" Panel 2: she points at Dad: "你呢？" Dad answers: "我也喝茶。"

alt.id: Kakak memegang bola dan menunjuk ke pintu: "我们走吧！" Adik mengangguk senang: "好！"
alt.en: Big Brother holds a ball and points at the door: "我们走吧！" Little Sister nods happily: "好！"

alt.id: Adik menunjuk dadanya sendiri: "我是学生。"
alt.en: Little Sister points at her own chest: "我是学生。"

alt.id: Adik berkata kepada Ibu sambil menunjuk Ayah di sana: "他是我爸爸。"
alt.en: Little Sister tells Mom while pointing at Dad over there: "他是我爸爸。"

alt.id: Kakak berkata kepada Ayah sambil menunjuk Nenek di seberang ruangan: "她是我奶奶。"
alt.en: Big Brother tells Dad while pointing at Grandma across the room: "她是我奶奶。"

alt.id: Adik menunjuk kucing di sofa dan berkata kepada Ibu: "它是我的猫。"
alt.en: Little Sister points at the cat on the sofa and tells Mom: "它是我的猫。"

alt.id: Adik merentangkan tangan merangkul Ibu dan Kakak: "我们是一家人！"
alt.en: Little Sister opens her arms to include Mom and Big Brother: "我们是一家人！"

alt.id: Ibu menunjuk Ayah dan Kakak yang bermain bola: "他们在玩儿。"
alt.en: Mom points at Dad and Big Brother playing ball: "他们在玩儿。"

alt.id: Ayah menunjuk Ibu, Nenek, dan Adik yang membuat pangsit bersama: "她们在包饺子。"
alt.en: Dad points at Mom, Grandma and Little Sister making dumplings together: "她们在包饺子。"

alt.id: Di taman, Adik menunjuk dua kucing dan seekor anjing yang bermain, dan berkata kepada Kakak: "你看它们！"
alt.en: In the park, Little Sister points at two cats and a dog playing, and tells Big Brother: "你看它们！"

alt.id: Ibu membuka pintu kamar dan membangunkan Kakak dan Adik yang masih tidur: "孩子们，起床了！"
alt.en: Mom opens the bedroom door and wakes Big Brother and Little Sister, still asleep in bed: "孩子们，起床了！"

alt.id: Ayah memegang foto bayi dan menunjuk Adik: "这是你。" Adik mengangguk.
alt.en: Dad holds a baby photo and points at Little Sister: "这是你。" She nods.

alt.id: Ada cangkir pecah di lantai dapur; Adik menggeleng dan menyilangkan tangan di depan Ibu: "不是我！"
alt.en: A broken cup lies on the kitchen floor; Little Sister shakes her head and crosses her arms in front of Mom: "不是我！"

alt.id: Kakak mengangkat tangan; Adik ikut mengangkat tangan: "我也要！"
alt.en: Big Brother raises his hand; Little Sister raises hers too: "我也要！"

alt.id: Di taman, Nenek membungkuk ramah dan bertanya kepada seorang anak kecil: "小朋友，你叫什么名字？"
alt.en: In the park, Grandma leans down kindly and asks a little boy: "小朋友，你叫什么名字？"

alt.id: Hari pertama sekolah: Adik menunjuk label nama di bajunya; Bu Guru membacanya dan berkata "你的名字很好听。"
alt.en: First day of school: Little Sister points at the name tag on her shirt; the teacher reads it and says "你的名字很好听。"

alt.id: Adik memeluk boneka beruangnya dan berkata "是我的！"; Kakak memegang bolanya.
alt.en: Little Sister hugs her teddy bear and says "是我的！"; Big Brother holds his ball.

alt.id: Adik berdiri di samping Kakak dan mengacungkan satu jari: "我有一个哥哥。"
alt.en: Little Sister stands next to Big Brother and holds up one finger: "我有一个哥哥。"

alt.id: Adik menunjuk jendela lantai dua gedung apartemennya, ada angka 2 di sampingnya: "我家在二楼。"
alt.en: Little Sister points at the second-floor window of her apartment building, with a number 2 beside it: "我家在二楼。"

alt.id: Adik menunjuk seorang teman kecil yang berdiri bersama tiga kakak laki-lakinya: "他有三个哥哥。"
alt.en: Little Sister points at a little friend standing with his three big brothers: "他有三个哥哥。"

alt.id: Di pintu restoran, Ayah mengacungkan empat jari kepada pelayan; Ibu, Kakak, dan Adik berdiri di belakangnya: "我们四个人。"
alt.en: At the restaurant door, Dad holds up four fingers to the waiter; Mom, Big Brother and Little Sister stand behind him: "我们四个人。"

alt.id: Di kedai bakpao, Ibu membuka lima jari kepada penjual; ada lima bakpao di nampan: "我要五个包子。"
alt.en: At the bun stall, Mom shows five fingers to the seller; five buns sit on the tray: "我要五个包子。"

alt.id: Ibu pulang membawa enam butir telur; Adik menunjuknya: "妈妈买了六个鸡蛋。"
alt.en: Mom comes home carrying six eggs; Little Sister points at them: "妈妈买了六个鸡蛋。"

alt.id: Kakak menepuk perut di depan piring kosong; tujuh pangsit tergambar di dekatnya: "我吃了七个饺子！"
alt.en: Big Brother pats his belly in front of an empty plate; seven dumplings are pictured beside him: "我吃了七个饺子！"

alt.id: Kakek tersenyum di depan kue ulang tahun, ada angka 80 di sampingnya; Adik bersorak: "爷爷八十岁了。"
alt.en: Grandpa smiles behind a birthday cake, a big number 80 beside him; Little Sister cheers: "爷爷八十岁了。"

alt.id: Jam dinding menunjuk pukul 9 malam; Ibu menunjuk tempat tidur Adik: "九点了，睡觉吧。"
alt.en: The wall clock shows nine at night; Mom points at Little Sister’s bed: "九点了，睡觉吧。"

alt.id: Sepuluh apel di meja (5 + 5); Adik menghitungnya: "这儿有十个苹果。"
alt.en: Ten apples on the table (5 + 5); Little Sister counts them: "这儿有十个苹果。"

alt.id: Kakak menunjuk jam dinding besar yang menunjukkan pukul 10.05: "现在十点零五分。"
alt.en: Big Brother points at a big wall clock showing 10:05: "现在十点零五分。"

alt.id: Adik duduk di sofa memangku dua kucing: "我家有两只猫。"
alt.en: Little Sister sits on the sofa with two cats on her lap: "我家有两只猫。"

alt.id: Ibu memegang permen dan bertanya "你要几个？"; Adik menunjukkan tiga jari: "三个！"
alt.en: Mom holds sweets and asks "你要几个？"; Little Sister shows three fingers: "三个！"

alt.id: Di pasar, Ayah menunjuk tumpukan jeruk: "这个多少钱？" Penjual menjawab: "三块钱一个。"
alt.en: At the market, Dad points at a pile of oranges: "这个多少钱？" The seller answers: "三块钱一个。"

alt.id: Kakak memperkenalkan Ibu kepada temannya dengan telapak terbuka: "这是我妈妈。"
alt.en: Big Brother introduces Mom to his friend with an open hand: "这是我妈妈。"

alt.id: Adik menunjuk gedung sekolah yang jauh di ujung jalan; Nenek ikut melihat: "那是我们的学校。"
alt.en: Little Sister points at the school far down the street; Grandma looks too: "那是我们的学校。"

alt.id: Adik menyodorkan boneka beruang di tangannya ke depan: "我要这个！" Mainan lain masih di rak.
alt.en: Little Sister holds out the teddy bear in her hand: "我要这个！" The other toys stay on the shelf.

bubbles.text: 这个是我的，那个是你的。

alt.id: Kakak memegang bola di dekatnya dan menunjuk bola lain yang jauh di lantai, bicara kepada Adik: "这个是我的，那个是你的。"
alt.en: Big Brother holds the ball next to him and points at another ball far away on the floor, telling Little Sister: "这个是我的，那个是你的。"

alt.id: Adik memeluk beberapa boneka di dadanya: "这些是我的！" Boneka lain ada jauh di rak.
alt.en: Little Sister hugs several stuffed toys to her chest: "这些是我的！" Other toys sit far away on a shelf.

alt.id: Ibu menunjuk beberapa mainan di rak yang jauh sambil bertanya kepada Adik: "那些是你的吗？"
alt.en: Mom points at some toys on a shelf across the room and asks Little Sister: "那些是你的吗？"

alt.id: Ibu duduk di sofa dan menepuk tempat kosong di sebelahnya, memanggil Adik: "来，坐这儿！"
alt.en: Mom sits on the sofa and pats the empty spot beside her, calling Little Sister: "来，坐这儿！"

alt.id: Kakak menunjuk kedai teh susu di seberang jalan sambil bicara dengan temannya: "我们去那儿吧！"
alt.en: Big Brother points at the milk tea shop across the street while talking to his classmate: "我们去那儿吧！"

alt.id: Ayah memegang peta taman dan menunjuk tanah tepat di dekat kakinya, ada tanda lokasi: "我们在这里。"
alt.en: Dad holds a park map and points at the ground right by his feet, where a location pin is: "我们在这里。"

alt.id: Kakek menunjuk pagoda jauh di atas bukit; Adik ikut melihat: "他们在那里！"
alt.en: Grandpa points far off to a pagoda on a hill; Little Sister looks: "他们在那里！"

alt.id: Di restoran, pelayan mempersilakan Ibu ke meja di dekatnya dengan telapak terbuka: "您好，这边请！"
alt.en: In a restaurant, the waiter shows Mom to the table right next to him with an open palm: "您好，这边请！"

alt.id: Pelayan menunjuk meja kosong jauh di dekat jendela: "请坐那边。"
alt.en: The waiter points to an empty table far away by the window: "请坐那边。"

alt.id: Di taman, Adik berdiri di tengah lima teman yang saling bergandengan tangan: "我有很多朋友。"
alt.en: In the park, Little Sister stands among five friends, all holding hands: "我有很多朋友。"

alt.id: Ibu membuka kulkas dan memegang kotak susu yang kosong: "家里没有牛奶了。"
alt.en: Mom opens the fridge and holds up an empty milk carton: "家里没有牛奶了。"

alt.id: Adik bersembunyi di dalam lemari, hanya kepalanya yang terlihat; panah menunjuk tempatnya: "我在这儿！"
alt.en: Little Sister hides in the wardrobe with only her head peeking out; an arrow points to her: "我在这儿！"

alt.id: Adik mengguncang kotak hadiah tertutup di dekat telinganya: "这是什么？" Ibu tersenyum: "这是你的新书。"
alt.en: Little Sister shakes a closed gift box next to her ear: "这是什么？" Mom smiles: "这是你的新书。"

alt.id: Panel 1: Kakek melihat cangkir pecah; Adik menggeleng: "不是我！" Kakek bertanya: "不是你？那是谁？" Panel 2: Adik menunjuk kucing: "是猫！"
alt.en: Panel 1: Grandpa sees a broken cup; Little Sister shakes her head: "不是我！" Grandpa asks: "不是你？那是谁？" Panel 2: she points at the cat: "是猫！"

alt.id: Di toko buku, Ibu bertanya di depan rak: "你要哪本书？" Adik menunjuk satu buku: "这本！"
alt.en: In a bookshop, Mom asks in front of the shelf: "你要哪本书？" Little Sister points at one book: "这本！"

alt.id: Di toko, Adik melihat tiga boneka beruang di rak dan bertanya kepada Ibu: "哪个好？" Ibu menjawab: "这个很好。"
alt.en: In a shop, Little Sister looks at three teddy bears on a shelf and asks Mom: "哪个好？" Mom answers: "这个很好。"

alt.id: Ibu menunjuk tumpukan buku di meja: "哪些是你的？" Kakak menunjuk sebagian buku: "这些都是。"
alt.en: Mom points at the piles of books on the table: "哪些是你的？" Big Brother points at some of them: "这些都是。"

alt.id: Di taman yang ramai, Ibu mencari Kakak: "他在哪儿？" Adik menunjuk Kakak di dekat pohon: "在那儿！"
alt.en: In a busy park, Mom looks for Big Brother: "他在哪儿？" Little Sister points at him by the tree: "在那儿！"

alt.id: Panel 1: Ibu menelepon dari rumah: "你在哪里？" Panel 2: Kakak menjawab di depan gerbang sekolah: "我在学校。"
alt.en: Panel 1: Mom phones from home: "你在哪里？" Panel 2: Big Brother answers in front of the school: "我在学校。"

alt.id: Kakek memegang ponsel baru dengan bingung: "这个怎么用？" Kakak mendekat: "我看看。"
alt.en: Grandpa holds a new phone, puzzled: "这个怎么用？" Big Brother comes over: "我看看。"

alt.id: Ibu menunjukkan baju barunya kepada Ayah: "这件衣服怎么样？" Ayah mengacungkan jempol: "很好看！"
alt.en: Mom shows Dad her new top: "这件衣服怎么样？" Dad gives a thumbs-up: "很好看！"

alt.id: Adik bertanya kepada Ayah; Ayah tersenyum dan menunjuk Ibu yang memasak di dapur: "你问她吧。"
alt.en: Little Sister asks Dad something; he smiles and points at Mom cooking in the kitchen: "你问她吧。"

alt.id: Bu Guru bertanya "有问题吗？"; Adik mengangkat tangan dengan tanda tanya besar di dekatnya.
alt.en: The teacher asks "有问题吗？"; Little Sister raises her hand, a big question mark beside her.

alt.id: Bu Guru bertanya "二加二是几？"; Adik menjawab "是四。"; Bu Guru tersenyum dan memberi centang di papan (2 + 2 = 4): "对，很好！"
alt.en: The teacher asks "二加二是几？"; Little Sister answers "是四。"; the teacher smiles and ticks the board (2 + 2 = 4): "对，很好！"

alt.id: Di kelas, Adik mengangkat tangan dengan satu jari kepada Bu Guru: "我有一个问题。"
alt.en: In class, Little Sister raises one finger to the teacher: "我有一个问题。"

alt.id: Nenek, Ibu, dan Adik di meja penuh nampan pangsit, angka 100 di atasnya: "我们做了一百个饺子！"
alt.en: Grandma, Mom and Little Sister at a table full of dumpling trays, the number 100 above: "我们做了一百个饺子！"

alt.id: Di toko, penjual menunjuk HP dengan label harga besar 1000; Ayah melihatnya: "这个手机一千块。"
alt.en: In a shop, the seller points at a phone with a big 1000 price label; Dad looks at it: "这个手机一千块。"

alt.id: Podium lomba lari: Kakak di nomor 1, temannya nomor 2, Ayah yang kelelahan nomor 3.
alt.en: A race podium: Big Brother is number 1, his classmate number 2, and a tired Dad number 3.

alt.id: Kalender dinding dengan tanggal 15 dilingkari; Adik menunjuknya: "今天是十五号。"
alt.en: A wall calendar with the 15th circled; Little Sister points at it: "今天是十五号。"

alt.id: Adik bersorak di depan kue ulang tahun dengan lilin angka 6: "我六岁！"
alt.en: Little Sister cheers in front of a birthday cake with a number-6 candle: "我六岁！"

alt.id: Nenek menyodorkan sepiring besar pangsit; Kakak mengangkat kedua tangan: "二十个饺子？太多了！"
alt.en: Grandma holds out a big plate of dumplings; Big Brother throws up both hands: "二十个饺子？太多了！"

alt.id: Dua mangkuk: satu penuh pangsit, satu hanya berisi dua. Adik cemberut menunjuk yang hampir kosong: "你的多，我的少！"
alt.en: Two bowls: one piled with dumplings, one with only two. Little Sister pouts and points at the nearly empty one: "你的多，我的少！"

alt.id: Ibu menunjuk jam dinding yang menunjuk pukul 7.30; Adik sedang sarapan: "现在七点半。"
alt.en: Mom points at the wall clock showing 7:30 while Little Sister eats breakfast: "现在七点半。"

alt.id: Kakak membagi bakpao jadi dua dan memberi setengahnya kepada Adik: "这一半是你的！"
alt.en: Big Brother breaks a steamed bun in two and gives half to Little Sister: "这一半是你的！"

alt.id: Teman kuliah tersenyum malu sambil memberi isyarat "sedikit" dengan jarinya: "我会说一点儿汉语。"
alt.en: A classmate smiles shyly and shows "a little" with his fingers: "我会说一点儿汉语。"

alt.id: Adik menyentuh cangkir teh yang mengepul dan memberi isyarat "sedikit" dengan jarinya: "茶有点儿热。"
alt.en: Little Sister touches a steaming cup of tea and shows "a little" with her fingers: "茶有点儿热。"

alt.id: Ibu menunjuk beberapa buku di atas meja belajar: "桌子上有一些书。"
alt.en: Mom points at some books on the study desk: "桌子上有一些书。"

alt.id: Di meja ada setumpuk besar jeruk; Ibu mengambil beberapa (empat) ke dalam mangkuknya.
alt.en: There is a big pile of oranges on the table; Mom takes a few (four) into her bowl.

bubbles.text: 这些苹果有的大，有的小。

alt.id: Di pasar, Ibu menunjuk apel di lapak: beberapa besar, beberapa kecil: "这些苹果有的大，有的小。"
alt.en: At the market, Mom points at the apples on the stall: some big, some small: "这些苹果有的大，有的小。"

alt.id: Di meja makan, Adik menolak beberapa masakan (pare dan sayur) dan memilih nasinya: "有些菜我不吃。"
alt.en: At the dinner table, Little Sister pushes away some dishes (bitter melon and greens) and keeps her rice: "有些菜我不吃。"

alt.id: Ayah menggandeng Adik di stasiun yang penuh orang: "这儿人很多。"
alt.en: Dad holds Little Sister’s hand in a station full of people: "这儿人很多。"

alt.id: Ibu dan temannya tertawa bersama sambil minum bubble tea di kedai.
alt.en: Mom and her friend laugh together over bubble tea at a tea shop.

alt.id: Kakak dan teman kuliahnya duduk bersebelahan di kelas, berbagi satu buku.
alt.en: Big Brother and his classmate sit side by side in class, sharing one book.

alt.id: Bu Guru berdiri di depan kelas dan melambai kepada semua murid: "大家好！"
alt.en: The teacher stands at the front of the class and waves to all the pupils: "大家好！"

alt.id: Pelayan membungkuk sopan menyambut Ayah di restoran: "先生，您好！"
alt.en: The waiter bows politely to welcome Dad at the restaurant: "先生，您好！"

alt.id: Pelayan membungkuk sopan menyambut Ibu yang membawa tas tangan: "女士，这边请。"
alt.en: The waiter bows politely to greet Mom, who carries a handbag: "女士，这边请。"

bubbles.text: 男同学在这边，女同学在那边。

alt.id: Di lapangan sekolah, Bu Guru membagi murid: anak laki-laki di kiri, anak perempuan di kanan: "男同学在这边，女同学在那边。"
alt.en: In the schoolyard, the teacher splits the class: boys on the left, girls on the right: "男同学在这边，女同学在那边。"

alt.id: Ibu bertanya kepada Kakak sambil menunjuk seorang gadis yang melambai dari jauh: "那个女孩子是谁？"
alt.en: Mom asks Big Brother, pointing at a girl waving from far away: "那个女孩子是谁？"

alt.id: Di taman, Ibu merangkul Kakak dan Adik sambil bicara dengan temannya: "我有两个孩子。"
alt.en: In the park, Mom puts her arms around Big Brother and Little Sister while talking to a friend: "我有两个孩子。"

alt.id: Guru membungkuk ramah dan menepuk kepala Adik: "小朋友，你好！"
alt.en: The teacher bends down kindly and pats Little Sister on the head: "小朋友，你好！"

alt.id: Seorang wanita muda menunjuk pemuda di sampingnya: "他是我男朋友。" Ada hati kecil di antara mereka.
alt.en: A young woman points at the young man beside her: "他是我男朋友。" Little hearts float between them.

alt.id: Seorang pemuda menunjuk wanita muda di sampingnya: "她是我女朋友。" Ada hati kecil di antara mereka.
alt.en: A young man points at the young woman beside him: "她是我女朋友。" Little hearts float between them.

alt.id: Adik merentangkan tangan ke arah empat anak yang melambai di taman: "他们都是我的朋友。"
alt.en: Little Sister holds out her hand toward four children waving in the park: "他们都是我的朋友。"

alt.id: Adik menunjuk seorang anak laki-laki dan anak perempuan yang bergandengan tangan sambil tertawa: "他和她是好朋友。"
alt.en: Little Sister points at a boy and a girl holding hands and laughing: "他和她是好朋友。"

alt.id: Teman Kakak datang ke pintu; Ibu menggeleng sambil menunjuk ke ruang keluarga yang kosong: "他不在家。"
alt.en: Big Brother’s friend comes to the door; Mom shakes her head and points at the empty living room: "他不在家。"

alt.id: Keenam anggota keluarga Xiǎo berdiri berjajar di ruang keluarga dan tersenyum.
alt.en: All six members of the Xiǎo family stand in a row in their living room, smiling.

alt.id: Di ruang keluarga, Adik berlari ke Ayah yang membuka tangan: "爸爸回来了！"
alt.en: In the living room, Little Sister runs to Dad, who opens his arms: "爸爸回来了！"

alt.id: Adik menggandeng teman perempuannya dan mengenalkannya kepada Ibu di ruang keluarga: "妈妈，这是我朋友。"
alt.en: Little Sister brings her friend by the hand and introduces her to Mom in the living room: "妈妈，这是我朋友。"

alt.id: Adik celingukan dan bertanya kepada Ibu; Kakak mengintip dari balik pintu kamar: "哥哥在哪儿？"
alt.en: Little Sister looks around and asks Mom; Big Brother peeks out from behind his bedroom door: "哥哥在哪儿？"

alt.id: Ibu menunjuk foto lama di dinding: ia waktu kecil bersama kakak perempuannya yang lebih tinggi (ditandai panah): "这是我姐姐。"
alt.en: Mom points at an old photo on the wall: herself as a little girl with her taller older sister (marked by an arrow): "这是我姐姐。"

alt.id: Ayah menunjuk foto lama di dinding: ia waktu remaja bersama adik laki-lakinya yang kecil (ditandai panah): "我有一个弟弟。"
alt.en: Dad points at an old photo on the wall: himself as a boy with his little brother (marked by an arrow): "我有一个弟弟。"

alt.id: Kakak menunjuk adik perempuannya yang kecil (ditandai panah): "我妹妹六岁。" Kakek dan Nenek duduk di sofa.
alt.en: Big Brother points at his little sister (marked by an arrow): "我妹妹六岁。" Grandpa and Grandma sit on the sofa.

alt.id: Ayah merangkul Kakak yang memegang piala dengan bangga: "这是我儿子！"
alt.en: Dad proudly puts his hand on Big Brother, who holds a trophy: "这是我儿子！"

alt.id: Teman Ibu bertamu dan bertanya sambil tersenyum; Ibu sedang menyisir rambut Adik: "这是你女儿吗？"
alt.en: Mom’s friend drops by and asks with a smile while Mom combs Little Sister’s hair: "这是你女儿吗？"

alt.id: Malam hari, Adik menunjuk satu jendela yang menyala di gedung apartemen; di dalamnya keluarganya sedang makan: "我住这儿！"
alt.en: At night, Little Sister points at one lit window of an apartment block where her family is eating: "我住这儿！"

alt.id: Kamar Adik: meja belajar, tempat tidur kecil, dan boneka; Adik duduk di lantai bermain.
alt.en: Little Sister's room: a desk, a small bed and soft toys; she sits on the floor playing.

alt.id: Kakak duduk di meja belajarnya dan menepuk mejanya dengan bangga: "这是我的桌子。"
alt.en: Big Brother sits at his study desk and pats it proudly: "这是我的桌子。"

alt.id: Kakek memegang koran dan menunjuk kursi kayu yang kosong (ditandai panah).
alt.en: Grandpa holds his newspaper and points at an empty wooden chair (marked by an arrow).

alt.id: Di taman, Adik bertanya kepada teman yang membawa anjing kecil berbulu kuning: "这是你家的狗吗？"
alt.en: In the park, Little Sister asks a friend who is walking a small yellow dog: "这是你家的狗吗？"

alt.id: Kucing belang oranye tidur melingkar di sofa; Adik mengelus kepalanya.
alt.en: An orange tabby cat sleeps curled up on the sofa; Little Sister strokes its head.

alt.id: Adik menunjuk tiga burung kecil di satu dahan, ada angka 3: "那儿有三只鸟。"
alt.en: Little Sister points at three little birds on one branch, with the number 3: "那儿有三只鸟。"

alt.id: Nenek menambahkan mi ke mangkuk Adik yang sedang makan dengan sumpit: "多吃一点儿！"
alt.en: Grandma adds more noodles to Little Sister’s bowl while she eats with chopsticks: "多吃一点儿！"

alt.id: Kakak minum bubble tea lewat sedotan besar.
alt.en: Big Brother drinks bubble tea through a big straw.

alt.id: Ibu memanggil "饭好了！"; di meja ada nampan berisi semangkuk nasi, sepiring sayur, dan sumpit.
alt.en: Mom calls "饭好了！"; on the table is a tray with a bowl of rice, a plate of greens and chopsticks.

alt.id: Nenek menyodorkan semangkuk nasi putih hangat dari penanak nasi.
alt.en: Grandma holds out a bowl of warm white rice from the rice cooker.

alt.id: Ibu membawa sepiring sayur tumis yang masih mengepul: "菜来了！"
alt.en: Mom carries a plate of steaming stir-fried greens: "菜来了！"

alt.id: Kakak kehausan dan bertanya; Ibu menunjuk botol air dan gelas di meja dapur: "妈妈，有水吗？"
alt.en: Thirsty Big Brother asks; Mom points at the water bottle and glass on the kitchen table: "妈妈，有水吗？"

alt.id: Adik menyodorkan cangkir kecil berisi teh hangat kepada Kakek; teko tanah liat di meja: "请喝茶。"
alt.en: Little Sister offers Grandpa a small cup of warm tea; a clay teapot stands on the table: "请喝茶。"

alt.id: Nenek menuang susu dari kotak susu bergambar totol sapi ke dalam gelas.
alt.en: Grandma pours milk from a cow-spotted carton into a glass.

alt.id: Gelas bergagang milik Adik, bergambar bintang, ada di meja; Adik mengulurkan tangan untuk mengambilnya.
alt.en: Little Sister's star-patterned mug with a handle sits on the table; she reaches for it.

alt.id: Nenek menyodorkan sepiring buah (semangka, pisang, apel, jeruk) kepada Adik yang senang.
alt.en: Grandma offers a plate of fruit (watermelon, bananas, an apple, an orange) to a happy Little Sister.

alt.id: Adik mengangkat satu apel merah di tiap tangan; keranjang apel di belakangnya: "我有两个苹果！"
alt.en: Little Sister holds up a red apple in each hand, a basket of apples behind her: "我有两个苹果！"

alt.id: Ibu mengangkat sebutir telur ayam; di wajan ada telur yang sedang digoreng.
alt.en: Mom holds up a hen's egg; another egg is frying in the wok.

alt.id: Ibu bertanya kepada Kakak yang sedang menggigit selembar roti tawar: "面包好吃吗？"
alt.en: Mom asks Big Brother, who is biting into a slice of bread: "面包好吃吗？"

alt.id: Di warung, Ibu bertanya kepada pelayan yang berdiri di samping kukusan bambu: "有包子吗？"
alt.en: At a small eatery, Mom asks the waiter standing next to the bamboo steamer: "有包子吗？"

alt.id: Nenek dan Adik membuat jiaozi di meja; sepiring jiaozi hangat ada di depan mereka.
alt.en: Grandma and Little Sister make dumplings at the table; a plate of warm dumplings is in front of them.

alt.id: Kakek mengangkat mi panjang tinggi-tinggi dengan sumpit dari semangkuk mi kuah.
alt.en: Grandpa lifts long noodles high with his chopsticks from a bowl of noodle soup.

alt.id: Dua panel: Adik mencicipi jiaozi dan mengacungkan jempol: "饺子很好吃！"; lalu mencicipi pare pahit dan cemberut.
alt.en: Two panels: Little Sister tastes a dumpling and gives a thumbs-up: "饺子很好吃！"; then she tastes bitter melon and grimaces.

alt.id: Keluarga tiba di penginapan membawa koper; di dinding ada kalender tiga hari: "我们在这儿住三天。"
alt.en: The family arrives at a guesthouse with a suitcase; a three-day calendar hangs on the wall: "我们在这儿住三天。"

alt.id: Tiga lembar kalender (24, 25, 26); lembar tengah 25 disorot kuning sebagai hari ini. Adik menunjuknya: "今天是星期一。"
alt.en: Three calendar pages (24, 25, 26); the middle one, 25, is highlighted as today. Little Sister points at it: "今天是星期一。"

alt.id: Kalender: hari ini 25 (kuning), panah biru maju ke 26 (hijau). Adik melompat senang: "明天是星期六！"
alt.en: Calendar: today is 25 (yellow) and a blue arrow jumps forward to 26 (green). Little Sister jumps for joy: "明天是星期六！"

alt.id: Kalender: hari ini 25 (kuning), panah biru mundur ke 24 (hijau). Kakak mengingat-ingat: "昨天是二十四号。"
alt.en: Calendar: today is 25 (yellow) and a blue arrow goes back to 24 (green). Big Brother tries to remember: "昨天是二十四号。"

alt.id: Satu minggu: tujuh kotak hari berjajar. Lima kotak bergambar tas sekolah, dua kotak terakhir bergambar bola; angka 7.
alt.en: One week: seven day boxes in a row. Five have a school bag, the last two have a ball; the number 7.

alt.id: Kalender seminggu, kotak terakhir (Minggu) menyala. Ayah bersantai di sofa; Adik menarik tangannya: "爸爸，今天是星期天！"
alt.en: A week strip whose last box (Sunday) glows. Dad lounges on the sofa; Little Sister tugs at his hand: "爸爸，今天是星期天！"

alt.id: Kotak terakhir kalender seminggu (Minggu) menyala; Keluarga Xiǎo berpiknik di taman: "星期日我们去公园。"
alt.en: The last box of a week strip (Sunday) glows; the Xiǎo family goes on a picnic in the park: "星期日我们去公园。"

alt.id: Di kelas, Bu Guru menunjuk tulisan "10月1日" di papan tulis sambil membacakan tanggal; murid-murid memperhatikan: "今天是十月一日。"
alt.en: In class, the teacher points at "10月1日" on the blackboard and reads the date aloud while the pupils watch: "今天是十月一日。"

alt.id: Adik menunjuk kalender besar bulan Mei yang tanggal 1-nya dilingkari: "今天是五月一号。"
alt.en: Little Sister points at a big May calendar with the 1st circled: "今天是五月一号。"

alt.id: Pohon yang sama dalam empat musim: berbunga, hijau, oranye, bersalju: satu tahun ("一年有十二个月。").
alt.en: The same tree in four seasons: blossoming, green, orange and snowy: one year ("一年有十二个月。").

alt.id: Adik mengangkat enam jari di samping kalender 2026 yang menyala: "我今年六岁。"
alt.en: Little Sister holds up six fingers next to the glowing 2026 calendar: "我今年六岁。"

alt.id: Panah maju dari kalender 2026 ke 2027; Adik mengangkat tujuh jari dengan gembira: "明年我七岁！"
alt.en: An arrow goes forward from the 2026 calendar to 2027; Little Sister happily holds up seven fingers: "明年我七岁！"

alt.id: Panah mundur dari kalender 2026 ke 2025, ada foto Adik waktu kecil; Adik mengangkat lima jari: "去年我五岁。"
alt.en: An arrow goes back from the 2026 calendar to 2025, with a photo of Little Sister when she was smaller; she holds up five fingers: "去年我五岁。"

alt.id: Siang hari, matahari bersinar terang; kucing tidur melingkar di sofa dan Adik menunjuknya: "猫白天睡觉。"
alt.en: In the daytime the sun shines bright; a cat sleeps curled up on the sofa and Little Sister points at it: "猫白天睡觉。"

alt.id: Adik menunjuk jam dinding besar yang menunjukkan pukul 8:00: "现在八点。"
alt.en: Little Sister points at a big wall clock showing 8:00: "现在八点。"

alt.id: Panel 1 (jam 5): Adik bertanya kepada Ibu yang memasak: "妈妈，我们几点吃饭？" Panel 2 (jam 6): Ibu menunjuk jam: "六点。"
alt.en: Panel 1 (five o’clock): Little Sister asks Mom, who is cooking: "妈妈，我们几点吃饭？" Panel 2 (six o’clock): Mom points at the clock: "六点。"

alt.id: Jarum menit (merah) maju lima menit dari pukul 3:00 ke 3:05 (bagian kuning); Ibu menunggu tehnya: "现在三点五分。".
alt.en: The (red) minute hand moves on five minutes from 3:00 to 3:05 (the yellow part); Mom waits for her tea: "现在三点五分。".

alt.id: Kakak di pintu kamar mengangkat lima jari kepada temannya yang menunggu; jam dengan bagian 5 menit berwarna kuning: "等我五分钟！"
alt.en: At his bedroom door, Big Brother holds up five fingers to his waiting friend; the clock shows five minutes in yellow: "等我五分钟！"

alt.id: Di kelas, Bu Guru memegang jam peraga besar; jarum panjang berputar satu putaran penuh (60 menit): "一个小时有六十分钟。"
alt.en: In class, the teacher holds up a big teaching clock; the long hand goes once all the way round (60 minutes): "一个小时有六十分钟。"

bubbles.text: 对不起，我今天没有时间。

alt.id: Adik menarik tangan Ayah untuk bermain bola; Ayah, dengan tas kerja, menunjuk jam (7.55) sambil minta maaf: "对不起，我今天没有时间。"
alt.en: Little Sister tugs at Dad’s hand to play ball; Dad, with his work bag, points at the clock (7:55) and apologises: "对不起，我今天没有时间。"

alt.id: Panel 1: Teman kuliah menelepon Kakak: "你什么时候有时间？" Panel 2: Kakak menjawab; di dinding kalender hari besok dan jam pukul 3: "明天下午。"
alt.en: Panel 1: A classmate phones Big Brother: "你什么时候有时间？" Panel 2: he answers, next to tomorrow on the calendar and a clock at three: "明天下午。"

alt.id: Pagi-pagi pukul 6: matahari baru terbit; Kakek dan Nenek berlatih taiji di taman: "早上好！"
alt.en: Early morning at 6: the sun has just come up; Grandpa and Grandma practise tai chi in the park: "早上好！"

alt.id: Pukul 10 pagi, matahari sudah cukup tinggi; Adik sedang belajar di kelas: "现在是上午十点。"
alt.en: At 10 in the morning the sun is fairly high; Little Sister is in class: "现在是上午十点。"

alt.id: Pukul 12 siang, matahari tepat di atas; Ayah membuka kotak bekalnya: "中午吃什么？"
alt.en: At 12 noon the sun is right overhead; Dad opens his lunch box: "中午吃什么？"

alt.id: Pukul 3 sore, matahari condong ke barat; Nenek menyiapkan teko teh untuk Kakek: "下午我们喝茶吧！"
alt.en: Three in the afternoon, the sun low in the west; Grandma brings a teapot for Grandpa: "下午我们喝茶吧！"

alt.id: Pukul 8 malam: langit gelap, bulan dan bintang; Adik mengucapkan "晚上好！".
alt.en: At 8 in the evening: dark sky with the moon and stars; Little Sister says "晚上好！".

alt.id: Pukul 7 di gerbang sekolah yang masih sepi; Bu Guru tersenyum menyambut Adik yang datang paling awal: "你今天很早！"
alt.en: Seven o’clock at the still-empty school gate; the teacher smiles at Little Sister, the first to arrive: "你今天很早！"

alt.id: Pukul 8:20, Kakak berlari terengah-engah ke sekolah; Bu Guru menunggu sambil bertolak pinggang: "你来晚了！"
alt.en: At 8:20 Big Brother runs breathlessly to school; the teacher waits, hands on her hips: "你来晚了！"

alt.id: Seekor kucing duduk di atas meja; panah kuning menunjuk kucing itu.
alt.en: A cat sits on top of the table; a yellow arrow points at the cat.

alt.id: Seekor kucing tidur di bawah meja; panah kuning menunjuk kucing itu.
alt.en: A cat sleeps under the table; a yellow arrow points at the cat.

alt.id: Antre di halte bus: Ayah berdiri di depan, Adik di belakangnya; panah menunjuk Ayah yang di depan.
alt.en: Queueing at the bus stop: Dad stands in front, Little Sister behind him; the arrow points at Dad in front.

alt.id: Antre di halte bus: Ayah berdiri di depan, Adik di belakangnya; panah menunjuk Adik yang di belakang.
alt.en: Queueing at the bus stop: Dad stands in front, Little Sister behind him; the arrow points at Little Sister at the back.

alt.id: Ibu menyodorkan gelas bening berisi air; panah menunjuk ke dalam gelas: "杯子里有水。"
alt.en: Mom holds out a clear glass of water; an arrow points into the glass: "杯子里有水。"

alt.id: Bayangan orang terlihat di luar pintu; Ibu di dalam mendengar ketukan, panah menunjuk ke luar: "门外有人。"
alt.en: A person’s shadow shows outside the door; Mom, inside, hears the knock, and an arrow points outside: "门外有人。"

alt.id: Kakak bermain bola di luar rumah; Nenek melihat dari dalam lewat jendela. Panah menunjuk Kakak di luar.
alt.en: Big Brother plays ball outside the house; Grandma watches from inside through the window. The arrow points at Big Brother outside.

alt.id: Adik berdiri di pinggir jalan dan menunjuk ke satu sisi, tempat pohon dan bangku: "来这边！"
alt.en: Little Sister stands at the roadside and points to one side, where a tree and a bench are: "来这边！"

alt.id: Ibu melambai memanggil "到妈妈这儿来！"; Adik berlari ke arah Ibu. Panah menunjuk ke Ibu.
alt.en: Mom beckons "到妈妈这儿来！"; Little Sister runs toward her. The arrow points toward Mom.

alt.id: Kakak berjalan menjauh dari rumah menuju rumah temannya yang melambai: "我去朋友家。"
alt.en: Big Brother walks away from home toward his friend’s house; the friend waves: "我去朋友家。"

alt.id: Ayah berbalik arah dan berjalan kembali ke rumah; panah berbentuk U menunjukkan ia kembali: "我们回家吧！"
alt.en: Dad turns around and walks back home; a U-shaped arrow shows him going back: "我们回家吧！"

alt.id: Pesawat sudah mendarat; Nenek keluar dari pintu kedatangan sambil membawa koper, Adik berlari menyambut: "奶奶到了！"
alt.en: The plane has landed; Grandma comes out of arrivals with her suitcase and Little Sister runs to meet her: "奶奶到了！"

alt.id: Kios buah kecil di pinggir jalan: keranjang apel dan jeruk di atas meja depan, penjual melambai dari dalam.
alt.en: A small fruit shop by the street: baskets of apples and oranges on the front counter, and the seller waves from inside.

alt.id: Toko kecil: rak penuh makanan ringan; Adik membawa tas belanja ke meja kasir, penjual di balik kasir dengan kode bayar.
alt.en: A small shop: a shelf full of snacks; Little Sister brings her shopping bag to the till, and the seller stands behind it with a payment code.

alt.id: Toko buku: dua rak penuh buku warna-warni (tanpa tulisan); Kakak berdiri di tengah sambil membaca buku.
alt.en: A bookshop: two shelves full of colourful books (no writing); Big Brother stands in the middle reading a book.

alt.id: Supermarket: Ibu mendorong troli berisi buah dan susu di antara rak buah, susu, dan mi.
alt.en: A supermarket: Mom pushes a trolley with fruit and milk between shelves of fruit, milk and noodles.

alt.id: Restoran: Kakek dan Nenek di meja bundar berputar yang penuh hidangan; pelayan datang membawa nampan berisi pangsit.
alt.en: A restaurant: Grandpa and Grandma at a round table with a turntable full of dishes; the waiter comes with a tray of dumplings.

alt.id: Bioskop yang gelap: layar besar bercahaya; Kakak dan temannya duduk di kursi merah menonton, dengan popcorn di antara mereka.
alt.en: A dark cinema: a big glowing screen; Big Brother and his friend sit in red seats watching, with popcorn between them.

alt.id: Gedung kantor tinggi berkaca; Ayah membawa tas kerja berjalan ke pintunya.
alt.en: A tall glass office building; Dad carries his briefcase and walks to its door.

alt.id: Jalan dengan beberapa kendaraan: bus hijau, mobil biru, dan sepeda.
alt.en: A road with several vehicles: a green bus, a blue car and a bicycle.

alt.id: Taksi kuning dengan lampu di atap (tanpa tulisan) berhenti; sopir di dalam, Ayah mengangkat tangan memanggil: "我们坐出租车去吧。"
alt.en: A yellow taxi with a roof light (no writing) pulls up with the driver inside; Dad raises his hand to call it: "我们坐出租车去吧。"

alt.id: Kereta cepat putih bergaris biru melaju di atas jembatan panjang melintasi sawah.
alt.en: A white high-speed train with a blue stripe speeds along a long bridge over rice fields.

alt.id: Pesawat terbang di langit biru meninggalkan jejak putih; Adik menunjuk ke atas: "飞机！"
alt.en: A plane flies across the blue sky leaving a trail; Little Sister points up: "飞机！"

alt.id: Kakak duduk di kursi kereta dan memandang ke luar jendela yang memperlihatkan bukit.
alt.en: Big Brother sits in a train seat and looks out of the window at the hills.

alt.id: Ayah menyetir mobil: dua tangan di kemudi, mata ke depan.
alt.en: Dad drives the car: both hands on the wheel, eyes on the road.

alt.id: Jam weker berdering pukul 7; Adik bangun, duduk di tempat tidur dan menggeliat dengan mata masih mengantuk.
alt.en: The alarm clock rings at 7; Little Sister wakes up, sits up in bed and stretches, still sleepy.

alt.id: Ibu memegang jaket terbuka; Adik memasukkan tangannya ke lengan jaket. Ibu: "穿这个吧！"
alt.en: Mom holds a jacket open and Little Sister puts her arm into the sleeve. Mom: "穿这个吧！"

alt.id: Gantungan baju berisi kemeja, gaun, dan celana; Adik mengangkat gaun ungu: "这是我的新衣服！"
alt.en: A clothes rail with shirts, a dress and trousers; Little Sister holds up a purple dress: "这是我的新衣服！"

alt.id: Pagi (matahari terbit, jam 7:30): sarapan susu kedelai, cakwe, dan bakpao; Ibu memanggil "吃早饭了！".
alt.en: Morning (rising sun, 7:30): breakfast of soy milk, fried dough sticks and steamed buns; Mom calls "吃早饭了！".

alt.id: Siang (matahari tinggi, jam 12): makan siang semangkuk mi dan dua bakpao; Nenek memanggil "我们午饭吃面条儿。".
alt.en: Noon (sun high, 12 o'clock): lunch of a bowl of noodles and two steamed buns; Grandma calls "我们午饭吃面条儿。".

alt.id: Malam (bulan, jam 7): makan malam keluarga dengan ikan, sayur, dan nasi di bawah lampu; Ayah berkata "我们吃晚饭吧！".
alt.en: Evening (moon, 7 o'clock): family dinner of fish, vegetables and rice under the lamp; Dad says "我们吃晚饭吧！".

alt.id: Ibu memasak di dapur, mengaduk wajan yang mengepul; Adik membantu membawa sayur.
alt.en: Mom cooks in the kitchen, stirring a steaming wok; Little Sister helps by bringing vegetables.

alt.id: Siang hari Kakek tertidur di kursi malas dengan buku terbuka di pangkuan; bulan kecil di dekat kepalanya.
alt.en: In the daytime Grandpa has dozed off in his armchair with an open book on his lap; a little moon floats by his head.

alt.id: Malam hari Adik tidur nyenyak di tempat tidurnya, berselimut, dengan boneka beruang; bulan terlihat di jendela.
alt.en: At night Little Sister is fast asleep in her bed under the blanket with her teddy bear; the moon shows in the window.

alt.id: Nenek dan Adik membuat pangsit bersama: Nenek menggiling kulit, Adik mengangkat pangsit buatannya. Nenek: "我们做饺子吧！"
alt.en: Grandma and Little Sister make dumplings together: Grandma rolls the wrappers and Little Sister holds up one she made. Grandma: "我们做饺子吧！"

alt.id: Adik mencari kucing dengan tangan di atas mata; kucing bersembunyi di balik sofa. Adik: "我在找我的猫。"
alt.en: Little Sister looks around for the cat, hand over her eyes; the cat is hiding behind the sofa. Little Sister: "我在找我的猫。"

alt.id: Kakak membuka jendela lebar-lebar; angin segar berembus masuk dan tirai berkibar.
alt.en: Big Brother opens the window wide; fresh air blows in and the curtain flutters.

alt.id: Dua panel: mangkuk penuh nasi dan Adik mulai makan; lalu mangkuk kosong, Adik mengacungkan jempol: "我吃完了！" (sebelum → sesudah).
alt.en: Two panels: a full bowl of rice as Little Sister starts eating; then the bowl is empty and she gives a thumbs-up: "我吃完了！" (before → after).

alt.id: Dua panel: Ibu menelepon "你在做什么？"; Adik yang sedang makan di depan semangkuk nasi menjawab "我正在吃饭。"
alt.en: Two panels: Mom phones "你在做什么？"; Little Sister, in the middle of eating a bowl of rice, answers "我正在吃饭。"

alt.id: Adik menyodorkan piring kosong ke Nenek yang punya sekukus bakpao: "再来一个！"
alt.en: Little Sister holds out her empty plate to Grandma, who has a steamer of buns: "再来一个！"

alt.id: Sudah malam: jam menunjuk pukul 11 dan bulan terlihat di jendela, tapi Kakak masih belajar di mejanya. Ibu: "你还在学习？"
alt.en: It is late: the clock shows 11 and the moon is in the window, but Big Brother is still studying at his desk. Mom: "你还在学习？"

alt.id: Ibu melambai memanggil Adik sebentar: "你来一下！"
alt.en: Mom waves Little Sister over for a moment: "你来一下！"

alt.id: Adik memeluk boneka panda pilihannya dari rak mainan, dikelilingi hati: "我很喜欢这个！"
alt.en: Little Sister hugs the stuffed panda she picked from the toy shelf, surrounded by hearts: "我很喜欢这个！"

alt.id: Ibu dan Adik berpelukan erat di ruang keluarga, hati melayang di sekitar mereka. Adik: "妈妈，我爱你！"
alt.en: Mom and Little Sister hug tight in the living room, hearts floating around them. Little Sister: "妈妈，我爱你！"

alt.id: Adik tersenyum lebar memegang balon merah di taman: "我很高兴。"
alt.en: Little Sister smiles widely, holding a red balloon in the park: "我很高兴。"

alt.id: Adik berdiri di dekat kedai bubble tea sambil berpikir; di awan pikirannya ada segelas bubble tea.
alt.en: Little Sister stands near a bubble tea shop thinking; her thought cloud holds a cup of bubble tea.

alt.id: Di toko mainan Adik menunjuk boneka beruang dengan tegas, Ayah di sampingnya: "爸爸，我要这个！"
alt.en: In a toy shop Little Sister points firmly at a teddy bear, Dad beside her: "爸爸，我要这个！"

alt.id: Ibu menyodorkan sepiring pare; Adik menggeleng dan mengangkat telapak tangan menolak: "我不要这个菜！"
alt.en: Mom holds out a plate of bitter melon; Little Sister shakes her head and raises her palm to refuse: "我不要这个菜！"

alt.id: Adik sudah bisa naik sepeda sendiri dengan bangga, Ibu bertepuk tangan: "看，我会了！"
alt.en: Little Sister can ride her bike on her own now and is proud of it, Mom claps: "看，我会了！"

alt.id: Adik bertanya "爸爸，你能吗？"; Ayah yang kuat mengangkat kardus besar tinggi-tinggi: "能！"
alt.en: Little Sister asks "爸爸，你能吗？"; strong Dad lifts a big box high above his head: "能！"

alt.id: Adik menunjuk kue di meja: "妈妈，我可以吃一个吗？" Ibu tersenyum dan mengacungkan jempol: "可以，吃吧！"
alt.en: Little Sister points at the cake on the table: "妈妈，我可以吃一个吗？" Mom smiles and gives a thumbs-up: "可以，吃吧！"

alt.id: Kakek mencicipi sup lalu mengusap dagu, berpikir: "我觉得很好吃。"
alt.en: Grandpa tastes the soup and rubs his chin, thinking: "我觉得很好吃。"

alt.id: Guru menulis soal 2+3 di papan tulis; Adik mengangkat tangan dengan yakin: "老师，我知道！"
alt.en: The teacher writes 2+3 on the board; Little Sister raises her hand confidently: "老师，我知道！"

alt.id: Ibu berkenalan dengan seorang wanita dan berjabat tangan: "你好！认识你很高兴。" Wanita itu menjawab: "我也很高兴认识你！"
alt.en: Mom meets a woman for the first time and shakes her hand: "你好！认识你很高兴。" The woman answers: "我也很高兴认识你！"

alt.id: Gedung sekolah berbendera; Adik dengan tas sekolah melambai pada guru di depan sekolah.
alt.en: A school building with a flag; Little Sister with her school bag waves to the teacher in front of the school.

alt.id: Dua murid (Adik dan seorang anak SMP) dengan tas sekolah di depan sekolah: "我们是学生。"
alt.en: Two students (Little Sister and a secondary school boy) with school bags in front of a school: "我们是学生。"

alt.id: Guru berkacamata berdiri di depan papan tulis memegang buku; Adik melambai: "老师，早上好！"
alt.en: The teacher with glasses stands in front of the blackboard holding a book; Little Sister waves: "老师，早上好！"

alt.id: Adik belajar naik sepeda dengan sedikit takut; Ibu memegangi sadelnya dari belakang.
alt.en: Little Sister is learning to ride a bike, a bit scared; Mom holds the saddle from behind.

alt.id: Siang hari Adik duduk belajar di meja belajarnya, membaca buku terbuka dengan tumpukan buku di sampingnya.
alt.en: In the daytime Little Sister sits studying at her desk, reading an open book with a pile of books beside her.

alt.id: Pagi hari Adik berangkat ke sekolah; Nenek melambai dari depan rumah. Adik: "我去上学了！"
alt.en: In the morning Little Sister sets off for school; Grandma waves from the house. Little Sister: "我去上学了！"

alt.id: Guru menunjuk jadwal pelajaran (angka 1–3 dengan gambar buku, bola, dan not musik): "今天有中文课。"
alt.en: The teacher points at the class timetable (numbers 1–3 with a book, a ball and a music note): "今天有中文课。"

alt.id: Bel berbunyi, guru masuk kelas: "同学们，上课了！"; Kakak dan temannya sudah duduk siap di bangku.
alt.en: The bell rings and the teacher comes in: "同学们，上课了！"; Big Brother and his friend sit ready at their desks.

alt.id: Bel berbunyi; Kakak dan temannya berlari gembira ke pintu keluar kelas, Kakak berseru "下课了！我们去吃饭吧！".
alt.en: The bell rings; Big Brother and his friend run happily to the classroom door, and Big Brother calls "下课了！我们去吃饭吧！".

alt.id: Sekolah dasar kecil yang dicat cerah dengan perosotan di halaman; Adik dengan tas sekolah melambai.
alt.en: A small brightly painted primary school with a slide in the yard; Little Sister with her school bag waves.

alt.id: Adik, murid SD, membawa tas sekolah besar dan melambai: "我是小学生。"
alt.en: Little Sister, a primary school pupil, carries a big school bag and waves: "我是小学生。"

alt.id: Sekolah menengah bertingkat empat dengan ring basket; seorang murid SMP membawa bola basket.
alt.en: A four-storey secondary school with a basketball hoop; a secondary school boy carries a basketball.

alt.id: Seorang murid SMP dengan ransel merah dan buku melambai di depan sekolahnya: "我是中学生。"
alt.en: A secondary school boy with a red backpack and a book waves in front of his school: "我是中学生。"

alt.id: Kampus universitas dengan gedung besar bertiang dan berkubah; Kakak dan teman kuliahnya di halaman kampus.
alt.en: A university campus with a big building with columns and a dome; Big Brother and a fellow student in the grounds.

alt.id: Kakak, mahasiswa, membawa laptop di depan kampus: "我是大学生。"
alt.en: Big Brother, a university student, carries a laptop in front of the campus: "我是大学生。"
